title: Nepal’s floods expose issues with climate-disaster funding — firmer policies are needed fast
title_zh: 尼泊尔洪水暴露气候灾害资金问题——迫切需要更坚定的政策
abstract: The UN’s climate loss and damage fund needs to consider how to make decisions about finance fairly and quickly, without disadvantaging low-resource nations.
abstract_zh: 联合国气候损失与损害基金需要考虑如何公平、迅速地做出融资决策，避免对资源匮乏的国家造成不利影响。
